_comment: soul_binder.json - what the Soul Binder at Lumora's Dawnspire Altar says (Scripts/soul_binder_npc.gd on a talking_vendor.tscn). Same shape as banker.json: greeting (when you hail), ambient/secret (said nearby every few minutes; secret only at night), topics (keywords said near them). A topic whose 'then' has hail: true offers the binding.
greeting: Aurethiel's light finds everyone who asks. Shall I bind your spirit to this place?
Come to be bound? The Dawnspire will remember you.
Kneel if you like. It isn't required. The binding holds either way.
ambient: Bind your spirit at the Dawnspire, traveller. The desert is long and the dark is longer.
Those who fall return to the place they are bound. Choose it well.
A silver for the candles. The light itself is free.
secret: Some nights I feel the bound ones come back before they do. A draught at the altar, like a door left open.
The casters bind themselves wherever they please. The rest of you have me. I don't mind.

lines: Of course. Stand still a moment.
